local function YSXC_fake_script() -- Fly.lol 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Fly)

	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local flying = false
	local BodyVelocity
	
	script.Parent.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if flying then
			flying = false
			if BodyVelocity then
				BodyVelocity:Destroy()
			end
			script.Parent.Text = "Enable Fly"
		else
			flying = true
			BodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
			BodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	
			-- Fly Control Loop
			spawn(function()
				while flying do
					local velocity = Vector3.zero
					local userInput = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
					if userInput:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
						velocity = velocity + (Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 50)
					end
					if userInput:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
						velocity = velocity - (Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 50)
					end
					if userInput:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
						velocity = velocity - (Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 50)
					end
					if userInput:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
						velocity = velocity + (Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 50)
					end
					if userInput:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
						velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
					end
					if userInput:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
						velocity = velocity - Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
					end
	
					BodyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
					wait()
				end
			end)
	
			script.Parent.Text = "Disable Fly"
		end
	end)
	
end
